items.title: The Los Angeles Clippers and Cam Christie have agreed to a two-way deal, agent Kevin Bradbury of LIFT Sports Management told HoopsHype. Christie, who recently turned 21, was the 46th pick of the 2024 NBA Draft and spent the past two seasons with the Clippers.
